speaker: Doctor
text: With normal IgE levels ruling out allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis, I need to consider other causes of chronic productive cough in a non-smoker. speaker: Doctor
text: With all standard workups for CF, ABPA, immunodeficiency, and interstitial lung disease returning normal, and given the classic presentation of chronic productive cough with recurrent bronchitis in a non-smoker, I must consider primary ciliary dyskinesia or a less common genetic defect despite previous assumptions.
